def test_auth_signup_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    signup_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup")
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    assert token is not None

    login_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/login")
    resp = requests.post(login_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token2 = resp.json().get("token")
    assert token2 is not None

    # Duplicate signup conflict
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_user_me():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    signup_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup")
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    me_url = get_url("gateway", "/user/me")
    resp = requests.get(me_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    data = resp.json()
    assert data.get("user") == username
    assert "name" in data
    assert type(data.get("enabled")) is bool

    # Unauthorized
    resp = requests.get(me_url, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_balance_and_topup():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    signup_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup")
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    balance_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance")
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    data = resp.json()
    assert data.get("balance") == 0
    address = data.get("address")
    assert address is not None

    topup_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup")
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    topup_data = resp.json()
    assert topup_data.get("address") == address
    new_balance = topup_data.get("balance")
    assert new_balance > 0

    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == new_balance

    # Topup again (conflict/error)
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    user_a = f"usera_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_a = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_a, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_a.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_a.status_code}: {resp_a.text}"
    token_a = resp_a.json().get("token")
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json().get("balance")
    address_a = resp.json().get("address")

    user_b = f"userb_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_b = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_b, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_b.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_b.status_code}: {resp_b.text}"
    token_b = resp_b.json().get("token")
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")
    balance_b = resp.json().get("balance")
    assert balance_b == 0

    transfer_amount = 10
    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_a - transfer_amount

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_a - transfer_amount

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_b + transfer_amount

    # Transfer 0 (no-op)
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": 0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Transfer to self (no-op)
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_a, "amount": 5}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_failures():
    user_a = f"usera_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_a = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_a, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_a.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_a.status_code}: {resp_a.text}"
    token_a = resp_a.json().get("token")
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json().get("balance")

    user_b = f"userb_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_b = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_b, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_b.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_b.status_code}: {resp_b.text}"
    token_b = resp_b.json().get("token")
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")

    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")

    # Insufficient funds
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": balance_a + 100}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative amount
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": -10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Non-existent wallet
    fake_address = f"fake_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": fake_address, "amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Missing amount
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Missing to
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Unauthorized
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, json={"to": address_b, "amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
